t: Horizon (character) - Apex Legends Wiki
s: September 17, 2025 - Dr. Mary Somers, better known as Horizon, is a Legend first introduced in Season 7 of Apex Legends. A famous scientist from the floating city of Olympus, she joined the Apex Games to fund time travel research in order to return to her young son, Newton. Dr. Mary Somers was born in 2609 on Psamathe.
